reason: The hypothesis cites no prior evidence, and its key premises about SRO absence, its effect on dislocation glide, and the ability to induce SRO via a specific thermal treatment in equimolar CoCrFeNiTi are specific claims unsupported by any cited passages.
premises: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi simple solid solution lacks atomic short-range order (SRO)
Lack of SRO results in low lattice friction and unimpeded dislocation glide
Low lattice friction explains lower hardness and yield strength despite high ductility
Sub-ordering thermal treatment at ~400°C can induce SRO in this alloy
Induced SRO increases local lattice friction, enhancing hardness and strength while retaining plasticity
